questions.question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.My way or the highway
options: To give a list of rules
To spoil or ruin someone's plans or event
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (To give an ultimatum) है।

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the group of words given in the brackets.The _____ (carefully watching someone or something, especially to prevent or detect a crime,) cameras, which monitored the area 24/7, ensured security and safety for everyone in the vicinity.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.We are working on ______ project to reduce ______ air pollution in India.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (a, No article) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate adjective to fill in the blank.The cake was so ____ that everyone at the party wanted a second slice.

Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.. Annie had to duck her head as the ceiling was so low. Duck here means ________________.15

questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow. The Solar System is the Sun and the objects that travel around it. The Earth is part of the Solar System because it also travels around the Sun. The Sun is a star similar to the other stars in the sky but it is much closer to the Earth. The Sun is mostly a big ball of gases composed mainly of hydrogen and helium. The planet Earth takes 365 days or one year to orbit the Sun. The other planets take more or less time to orbit the Sun. It takes Mercury less than two months, or 88 days, to travel around the Sun. It is the shortest time compared to the other planets. The planet taking the longest time to go around the Sun is Neptune. Neptune takes almost 165 years to travel around the Sun. Other objects in space include the moons of the six planets. Select the option that best describes the central theme of the passage.
options: Facts related to the Solar System
Time taken by planets to move around the Sun
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Facts related to the Solar System) है।
